t_snd
A stream sound: uncompressed PCM, one block per frame, paced by the timeline.

Listen for: four clicks a second apart, each on the frame the yellow square flashes, over a quiet steady drone. A click that is early or late by a frame is the pacing; a step or a stutter in the drone is the ring.

Stage 320 x 240, drawn at 1:1, 12fps, a four second loop.
